theme: Ugin's Allies and Heroes: the Eldrazi sealers, Tarkir and the Gatewatch (Phase 6 Pilot 3)
status: UNAPPROVED PROPOSAL - awaiting Cory's review; not approved, not locked, not certified
narrator_note: A four-colour story procession built on Pack A5. Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri seal the Eldrazi; Nahiri is left alone as warden; Sorin seeks Ugin on Tarkir as Sarkhan rewrites the past; Jace visits the Eye of Ugin as the Gatewatch forms; and Tarkir: Dragonstorm brings the gem, the brothers' clash and Narset carried away. Jace, Multiverse Architect leads as the ally Ugin counselled.

commander.name: Jace, Multiverse Architect
commander.why: Jace Beleren as a named character card that can be your commander. He travelled to the Eye of Ugin to learn about the hedron network, and Ugin warned him not to kill the titans and not to let them escape (U010, U011); he later seized Ugin's gem (U013). The card's Reality Fracture setting is not asserted to be any of these events.

canon_caveats: Caption-atlas cards (LORE_INSPIRED) only show that Wizards embedded that card's art in a cited official story page; they do not assert that the art depicts a story scene.
U016 (Elspeth carries Narset into the Omenpath) is CANON_IMPLIED; no card cites it.
Jace, Multiverse Architect (Reality Fracture Commander, 2026) is a Jace character card; its own story setting is not tied to the Ugin claims.
No in-universe (AR) dates are asserted; Pack A5 records none.
Kaya and Teyo (War of the Spark allies) are not included: Pack A5 has no evidence for them yet.
unrepresentable_in_identity: Green: Nissa's Oath of Nissa and Nissa's Judgment, the Kiora card, General Tazri (WUBRG ally identity), Dragonlord Atarka, Sarkhan Unbroken, Explore and Zendikar Resurgent are embedded in the cited stories but are outside WUBR.

tier_definitions.DIRECT_DEPICTION: Official Wizards story captions this exact art at the event (none in this pilot).
tier_definitions.CANON_REFERENCE: The card names a character, place or being that a cited CANON_CONFIRMED Pack A5 claim is about.
tier_definitions.LORE_INSPIRED: Its art is embedded in a cited official story page (caption atlas), or it is a named character with only an implied claim; no scene or event asserted.
tier_definitions.MECHANICAL_SYMBOL: Included for function; no story claim.
